steps.note: Opens the prepared staggered event whose first line has expired.
Enables lot scheduling and split support required for staggered line-item reopening.
Opens the event Settings menu where Reopen Line Items should be offered.
Confirms the buyer is offered the reopen action in the expired staggered-event state.

args.goal: from the open Settings menu, choose Reopen Line Items, select line 1, confirm the reopening, and stop on the resulting screen showing that line 1 is open for bids again until its new end time

steps.note: Performs the menu flow and verifies the reopened line and its new bidding end time from the buyer's screen.
Confirms the completed reopen flow did not produce an application error.
